title: Source-bound material composition and process history
body:
# Source-bound material composition and process history

This continuation applies the [shared universal contract](12-Universal-Core-Stage-1.md) to [NIST SRM 126c](../../records/0026-Iron-Fe/data/properties/0026-Iron-Fe-SRM-126c.yaml). The permanent child identity is `MAT:0026:MATERIAL:NIST-SRM-126c`; `parent_id` identifies Iron ownership and is not a material alias. Source SRC-000346 is registered once in the [existing registry](../../data/registries/sources.yaml): [NIST certificate](https://tsapps.nist.gov/srmext/certificates/126c.pdf), issued 22 June 2017, [retained PDF](../../data/research/sources/nist-srm-126c-2017-06-22.pdf). Retrieved bytes are hash-checked; source transcription and independent experimental replication are distinct.

## Composition and metrology

Eleven assignments are preserved: four certified, six reference and one information value. [The adapter](../../scripts/mat-material.mjs) retains each classification alongside EVALUATED evidence. Certified/reference assignments preserve expanded uncertainty, source coverage factors and 95% confidence; the information value retains unknown uncertainty. Constituent IDs resolve to the recognised catalogue, and analytical-method codes resolve to the certificate appendix.

The arithmetic projection has `basis=MASS`, `unit=wt%`, `coverage=PARTIAL`. Central values sum to 36.872 mass%; the unreported balance remains unidentified. MAT does not assign it to Iron, renormalise it into a complete recipe, combine uncertainties without covariance or predict performance. Nominal 36% nickel in the certificate title is not substituted for the assigned 36.054% value.

Scientific metrology stays in typed readings with owner/source pointers and hashes. Arithmetic functions still reject uncertain component metadata; adjustment modes require complete composition. Cross-basis conversion needs a separately reviewed physical model. No uncertainty is silently discarded into an adjusted scientific candidate.

## Reported process genome

The certificate describes vacuum melting → casting → rolling selected sections → NIST lathe cutting. Unique process IDs, owned states, connected order, final chip state and owner locators are validated. Approximately 130 mm rounds and approximately 85 mm remaining rods retain APPROXIMATE qualifiers and unknown uncertainty. Remaining rods are represented separately from chips.

The recommended 200 mg analytical sample quantity is applicability metadata, not a MAT sample measurement. Manufacturing temperatures, durations, cooling history, phase fractions and possession of a physical MAT sample remain unasserted. Analytical-method codes describe composition analysis rather than manufacturing steps.

## Compatibility, export and acceptance

Migration is additive: one new scientific child owner/source snapshot; pre-existing scientific owners and IDs remain intact. `material_id`, `process_id` and `sample_id` are supported subject aliases; conflicts fail. Legacy global IDs such as `MAT:MAT:NAK` remain untouched and are not automatically migrated into the numeric-root adapter.

Use `node scripts/mat-query-service.mjs --materials --pretty` or the existing `/materials` read-only endpoint. The material also appears in [master-update intake](../../data/quality/mat-update-intake.json) and universal validation. The base catalogue retains empty numeric projections; this source adapter explicitly supplies reviewed source readings. Universal owner coverage reached 191 objects at this material checkpoint; the [neutral-H continuation](12-Universal-Core-Stage-1.md) adds the existing atomic child as object 192.

[Tests](../../scripts/tests/mat-material.test.mjs) cover source status, uncertainty, partial balance, process pointers, hash/version drift, constituent/method/state resolution and API export. Whole composition/process/property/performance acceptance stays open under tasks 018, 020 and 131 in [MAT-TODO](../../data/quality/MAT-TODO.json).

## Owner binding and property boundaries

The material adapter now reloads the recorded owner file and JSON pointer before projecting readings. The supplied hash must match the current file, and the supplied document must equal the resolved owner document. A changed constituent value cannot inherit the unchanged owner's provenance. For a material stored at a nested pointer, each composition, preparation and parameter pointer retains that owner prefix and resolves back to the corresponding row. The existing SRM 126c composition and read-only export contract remain supported.

This certificate adapter handles composition and reported preparation history. It rejects top-level `properties` or `readings` extensions rather than silently omitting them. A scalar material-property adapter still needs reviewed source, object, state, units, method and measurement-context bindings. The [universal contract](12-Universal-Core-Stage-1.md) already supports scalar readings with unknown uncertainty; schema compatibility alone does not establish scientific eligibility.

The next source review traced the [S100a silica-glass portal](https://srdata.nist.gov/CeramicDataPortal/Silicate/Glss100a) Air/applied-moment double-cantilever-beam row to MEC74 in Table 3, printed page 19 of [NBS Technical Note 1212](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/TN/nbstechnicalnote1212.pdf). Its method key and derivation rule appear on printed page 3. An [official government-repository copy](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-C13-d7d86cacc65c7f4c065a192ad14baee9/pdf/GOVPUB-C13-d7d86cacc65c7f4c065a192ad14baee9.pdf) was captured and visually inspected; direct NIST byte retrieval failed, so byte equivalence is unverified. The compilation can calculate missing toughness or fracture energy from the other quantity and modulus. This row does not identify that direction. Its primary citation matches Mecholsky, Rice and Freiman's [1974 paper](https://ceramics.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1151-2916.1974.tb11377.x), but the original table and experimental section were inaccessible.

This remains a private compiled-reading candidate. Measurement versus derivation, row evaluation, uncertainty, temperature, pressure, humidity, loading rate, specimen details and source-specific reuse rights remain unresolved. Portal/report agreement supports transcription corroboration, not independent experimental replication. No scientific source ID, material/state child, numeric reading or standalone panel has been admitted. Silicon and Oxygen are constituent context; the glass property is not an elemental Silicon reading. Original captures, exact locators, hashes and failed retrievals are retained under `.mat-local/s100a-source-review-2026-10-12/`; the [existing selector](../../data/research/mat-update-review.json) and [continuation handoff](../../MAT_CODEX_CONTINUATION_HANDOFF.md) record the evidence and next executable task.

sources.scope: Pages 1-2, eleven mass-fraction assignments with distinct certified, reference and information status; conditional validity and sample-use scope; page 2 reported preparation; page 4 analytical-method codes. No iron balance, complete recipe, phase fraction or physical property prediction inferred.
